text:
Market today: The mood is cautious for tech and chips. Concerns over AI spending justification (Alibaba) and a broad sell-off in memory stocks (Samsung) are the real drivers, amplified by warnings of potentially higher bond yields. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.61%) is in deep trouble, being a leveraged product. SMH (-11.94%) and QQQI (-3.85%) are both near their stops and need attention. SPAL (-42.39%) is a brand-new, very volatile leveraged IPO already down significantly; margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements and how the market reacts to further news on AI spending justification.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged positions and key holdings near stops, risk management is paramount today.
plays: SOXL: Consider cutting losses or tightening your stop significantly given the deep drawdown and leveraged nature.
SMH: Respect your 540 stop. If it breaks, trim as planned to protect capital.
SPAL: Re-evaluate this new, highly volatile leveraged position given its rapid, deep loss.
